core_principles: Maximum Legibility: Optimized for elderly users and officials with large type, strong hierarchy, and minimal cognitive load.
High Contrast & Clarity: Strict adherence to WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios. No low-contrast grays, no glassmorphism.
Progressive Disclosure: Show only what's necessary. Reduce clutter on the dashboard to lower cognitive friction.
Swiss Structuralism: Use a rigid, grid-based layout with sharp borders and distinct sections instead of floating elements and soft shadows.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-black leading-tight

rules: Base font size must be effectively text-lg for optimal elderly readability.
Never use font weights below 400 (regular). Prefer 500 (medium) for interactive elements.
Ensure all headings use tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) to maintain structural look.

surfaces.cards: bg-gray-50 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-none md:rounded-md shadow-none
surfaces.modals: bg-white border-2 border-gray-900 rounded-md shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.12)] p-8

buttons.primary: bg-[#0052CC] text-white font-semibold text-lg px-6 py-3 rounded-md border-2 border-transparent hover:bg-[#003D99] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-300 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-900 font-semibold text-lg px-6 py-3 rounded-md border-2 border-gray-300 hover:border-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-50 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-gray-200 transition-all
buttons.danger: bg-[#B91C1C] text-white font-semibold text-lg px-6 py-3 rounded-md hover:bg-[#991B1B] focus:ring-4 focus:ring-red-300 transition-all

inputs.text: bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 text-gray-900 text-lg rounded-md focus:border-[#0052CC] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0052CC] p-3 w-full
inputs.select: bg-white border-2 border-gray-300 text-gray-900 text-lg rounded-md focus:border-[#0052CC] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0052CC] p-3 w-full

badges.low_risk: bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-2 border-green-200 text-sm font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wide
badges.medium_risk: bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-2 border-yellow-300 text-sm font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wide
badges.high_risk: bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-2 border-red-200 text-sm font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wide

components.navigation: bg-white border-b-2 border-gray-200 py-4 px-6 md:px-12 flex justify-between items-center sticky top-0 z-50
components.graph_visualization: Simple D3.js or react-force-graph-2d. Clean white background. Nodes colored by risk level (Red/Yellow/Green). Large text labels on nodes. Strict max 15 nodes. High contrast borders on nodes.

interactions_and_accessibility.hover_states: Must significantly darken the background or text color to maintain contrast. Provide a 2px border shift if background doesn't change.
interactions_and_accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus ring (e.g., `focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-300 focus:outline-none`).
interactions_and_accessibility.motion: Keep minimal. Use fast, simple opacity and transform transitions (e.g., `duration-150 ease-in-out`). Avoid bouncy or dramatic effects.
interactions_and_accessibility.data_testid: ALL buttons, links, inputs, and major sections must have descriptive kebab-case `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `upload-pdf-button`, `clause-card-high-risk`).
interactions_and_accessibility.screen_readers: Ensure proper ARIA labels for the upload zone and the interactive graph.

icons.style: Regular or Bold weight, size 24px or 32px for clear visibility. Avoid Light or Thin weights.

images.description: Clean, organized minimalist modern office. Use as a heavily muted, low-opacity background or hero image if needed.
Smiling female lawyer in professional setting. Use for the Lawyer Consultation Booking interface.
Man in a suit near a wooden table. Alternative lawyer profile.
Writing on a legal document. Use for empty states in document upload or analysis.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize the `IBM Plex Sans` font for all UI elements to ensure clean, structured, and large text perfect for elderly legibility. Make the default text size `text-lg` where possible.
Do NOT use `Card` components from Shadcn if they rely on soft drop-shadows. Override them to have flat backgrounds and solid 2px borders (`border-2 border-gray-200`).
The UI should feel like a 'Control Room' for legal documents. High contrast, no gradient overlays, and no decorative glassmorphism.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for highly visible icons (Regular or Bold weight).

For the Graph visualization (Node/Edge), keep it minimal. Use simple circles for nodes colored by risk (Red, Yellow, Green) and plain solid lines for edges. Restrict to max 15 nodes to avoid clutter, as requested.

Implement the UI using pure HTML+Tailwind for layouts, and Shadcn for interactive pieces (Select, Modals, Forms), but customize Shadcn to strip away 'Vercel-like' subtleties in favor of strong Swiss structuralism.
Highlighting the PDF should be visually distinct: high contrast Red/Orange/Green backgrounds for the text, with text color adjusted if necessary to ensure readability.
MANDATORY: Add `data-testid` attributes to all functional elements.
